content.comment_body: I notice some inputs in the function block diagram have a black dot, while others don’t. I assume the black dot means the input is inverted, but I can’t find any instructions for how to set an input as inverting, especially for the two text displays—one appears inverted, the other does not. Maybe I’m using the wrong terminology in the [product_name] manual or help. Any advice would be appreciated.
Hello, simply double-click on the input connection point.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. To invert an input, right-click the input and select the invert option from the shortcut menu. Please note, you can’t invert outputs. Alternatively, you can also double-click the input.
Refer to the attached screen video for a visual guide.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unsure about inverting connections in the function block diagram interface. Documentation and in-app help for this feature are not easily accessible, resulting in workflow delays and additional effort spent seeking answers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect an intuitive way to invert inputs, along with thorough documentation or help resources that clarify the graphical indicators and explain relevant actions.
